description: He wears an opaque dark-green knee-length tunic bordered in muted gold knotwork at neck, front, cuffs and hem, over a pale underlayer. A large dark-green and brown checked cloak drapes diagonally across the shoulders from a round decorated silver-gold-toned brooch, with knotwork borders and fringe. A broad brown leather-looking belt has a round central ornament, smaller fittings and a long metal-decorated strap. Brown trousers tuck into tall cross-strapped brown boots. The textured textiles appear wool-like; exact fibers are not verified. No headgear, armor or weapon is visible.
